about_the_game:
DCS: Cold War Germany, developed by Ugra-Media, recreates central Europe at the height of the Cold War in the 1980s. Created by the developers of the acclaimed DCS: Syria and Normandy, this map of West Germany, East Germany, Poland, Czechoslovakia, and the Low Countries centers on the strategically important Fulda Gap, and it also includes part of the Baltic Sea. The area measures 980x800 km and accurately reproduces the cities of Berlin, Frankfurt, Hamburg, Magdeburg, Leipzig, Hannover, Lübeck and others. 

The map features over 100 highly detailed military airfields and heliports such as Ramstein, Spangdahlem, Hahn, Bitburg, Sembach and large civil airfields like Tegel, Schönefeld, Tempelhof, Frankfurt, Hamburg, and Hannover. Numerous army bases, listening posts, naval bases, training grounds, weapon storage facilities, and the militarized frontier between East and West Germany. 

Ugra-Media has invested in detail, providing users a rich environment for endless complex missions and campaigns with accurate reproduction of the road and rail network, along with the power plants and grid, industrial sites, mines, tunnels, stadiums, rail yards and stations, and cultural landmarks. The initial release of the map will focus on the central portion of Germany with summer textures that will allow the creation of "what if" scenarios in Europe. Later updates will add additional detail, airfields, and other features to the north and south, as well as west to include The Netherlands, Belgium, and Denmark with Spring, Autumn, and Winter textures. 

Key Features 

  • 980x800 km of 1980s West Germany, East Germany, Poland, Czechoslovakia, and the Low Countries. 

  • The Fulda Gap and numerous major cities such as Berlin, Frankfurt, Hamburg, Magdeburg, Leipzig, and Hannover. 

  • High-Quality Ground Objects and Textures: Enhanced models and textures for buildings, vehicles, cultural and historic points of interest, and environmental elements. 

  • Over 100 Authentic and Detailed Air Bases: Accurate recreation of all significant airfields and military installations. 

  • Diverse Landscapes: From forests, fields, and rolling hills to coastlines and urban centers, experience the full geographic diversity of central Europe. 

  • Mission Content: A wide array of single player spanning many popular DCS aircraft. 

  • Summer Textures. Features Coming During Early Access 

  • Terrain Refinements: Ongoing enhancements to terrain details and environmental elements. 

  • Expanded Landmarks: Addition of more cultural, historical, and strategic sites across the map. 

  • Spring, Autumn, and Winter textures. 

  • Performance Optimizations: Regular updates for bug fixes, performance improvements, and new features based on community feedback. 

  • Future Expansions: Later development phases will expand the map to the North, East, South and West.
